title: Brazil Holds High-Stakes Presidential Election
subtitle: Voters choose between the current left-wing president and a new far-right challenger in a race that could change the future of Latin America.

summary.en: Brazil has finished voting in the first round of a very important presidential election. The current president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is facing a strong challenge from senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The election is seen as a battle between two very different visions for the country. If no candidate wins more than half of the votes, a second round will take place on October 25. The result of this vote will likely affect the political direction of the entire Latin American region.
summary.zh: 巴西已完成一場極為重要的總統大選首輪投票。現任總統魯拉正面臨參議員弗拉維奧·波索納洛的強勢挑戰。這場選舉被視為該國兩種截然不同願景的對決。若無候選人獲得過半選票，將於 10 月 25 日舉行第二輪投票。此次選舉結果極可能影響整個拉丁美洲地區的政治走向。

paragraphs.en: Polls have closed in Brazil for the first round of a presidential election that is being closely watched across the world. This vote is very important because it could change the political direction of Latin America’s largest country and the surrounding region. The race features two main candidates with very different ideas: the current left-wing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro.
paragraphs.zh: 巴西總統大選首輪投票已經結束，這場選舉受到全球密切關注。此次投票至關重要，因為它可能改變拉丁美洲最大國家及其周邊地區的政治走向。選戰主要由兩位理念截然不同的候選人角逐：現任左派總統魯拉 (Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva)，以及極右派參議員弗拉維奧·波索納洛 (Flávio Bolsonaro)。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, this election is highly divided. Lula, who is 80 years old, is looking for a fourth term in office. He is one of the few leaders in the region who still represents a left-wing government, as many other countries in Latin America have recently seen right-wing leaders win power. On the other side, Flávio Bolsonaro is the son of former president Jair Bolsonaro. The former president is currently serving a 27-year prison sentence for trying to take power by force after losing his own re-election attempt in 2022.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》報導，這場選舉呈現高度分裂。現年 80 歲的魯拉正尋求第四個任期。他是該地區少數仍代表左派政府的領導人之一，因為拉丁美洲許多其他國家近期皆由右派領導人勝出。另一方面，弗拉維奧·波索納洛是前總統雅伊爾·波索納洛 (Jair Bolsonaro) 的兒子。這位前總統因在 2022 年競選連任失敗後試圖以武力奪權，目前正服 27 年刑期。

paragraphs.en: Lula has presented himself as a leader who is willing to stand up to the United States. He has even accused the U.S. president of trying to interfere in Brazil’s election to help his opponent. In contrast, Flávio Bolsonaro has frequently praised the U.S. president. He has promised that, if he wins, he will join a U.S.-led coalition against drug cartels. This coalition has been involved in military operations and airstrikes in the region that have caused many deaths.
paragraphs.zh: 魯拉將自己塑造成一位願意對抗美國的領導人。他甚至指控美國總統試圖干預巴西選舉以幫助他的對手。相比之下，弗拉維奧·波索納洛經常讚揚美國總統。他承諾若勝選，將加入美國領導的打擊販毒集團聯盟。該聯盟曾參與該地區的軍事行動與空襲，並造成多人死亡。

paragraphs.en: The race has been very close, making it difficult for experts to predict the winner. Both candidates have spent their final days trying to convince undecided voters to support them. To win in the first round, a candidate must receive more than 50% of the total votes. If neither candidate reaches this number, the country will hold a runoff — a second election round between the top two candidates — on October 25.
paragraphs.zh: 選情十分膠著，專家難以預測勝負。兩位候選人在最後幾天都致力於說服尚未決定的選民支持自己。若要首輪勝出，候選人必須獲得超過總票數的 50%。若無人達到此門檻，巴西將於 10 月 25 日舉行決選，即由得票率最高的兩位候選人進行第二輪投票。

paragraphs.en: While voting in the city of São Bernardo do Campo, Lula told reporters that the people of Brazil have a clear choice to make. He described the election as a decision between strengthening democracy and what he called “barbarism.” He also noted that he was not worried about recent polls that showed the race was very close, saying that the only poll that truly matters is the one happening on election day.
paragraphs.zh: 魯拉在聖貝納多-杜坎普市投票時向記者表示，巴西人民面臨明確的選擇。他形容這場選舉是在強化民主與他所謂的「野蠻行徑」之間做決定。他也提到，自己並不擔心近期顯示選情緊繃的民調，並表示唯一真正重要的民調就是選舉當天開出的結果。

paragraphs.en: Flávio Bolsonaro voted in Rio de Janeiro and encouraged supporters of other right-wing candidates to switch their support to him. He expressed hope that this “protest vote” would be enough to give him a victory without needing a second round. Some voters, like 45-year-old workshop manager Claudinei Ferreira Viana, have decided to support the senator because they feel he is the only right-wing candidate strong enough to challenge the current president. Viana mentioned that he would have preferred to vote for the former president, but since he is under house arrest, he sees the son as the best alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 弗拉維奧·波索納洛在里約熱內盧投票，並鼓勵其他右派候選人的支持者轉而支持他。他表達希望這股「抗議票」足以讓他無需進入第二輪投票即可勝出。部分選民，例如 45 歲的工廠經理克勞迪內·費雷拉·維亞納 (Claudinei Ferreira Viana)，決定支持這位參議員，因為他們認為他是唯一有足夠實力挑戰現任總統的右派候選人。維亞納提到，他原本傾向支持前總統，但由於對方目前處於居家監禁狀態，他認為其子是最佳替代人選。

paragraphs.en: The campaign has not been without controversy. Flávio Bolsonaro faced a scandal after being recorded on tape asking a banker, who was accused of corruption, for a large amount of money to fund a film about his father. Despite this and other issues, he has remained a very strong competitor. Analysts suggest that his success comes from a mix of his father’s loyal supporters and voters who simply want to see a change from the current government.
paragraphs.zh: 競選過程並非沒有爭議。弗拉維奧·波索納洛曾捲入醜聞，當時一段錄音顯示他向一位被控貪腐的銀行家索取鉅款，以資助一部關於他父親的電影。儘管面臨此類問題，他仍是極具威脅的競爭對手。分析人士認為，他的成功來自於他父親的忠實支持者，以及單純希望看到政府更迭的選民之結合。

paragraphs.en: As the country waits for the final results, the impact of this election remains a major topic of discussion. Brazil is currently one of the few remaining nations in the region with a left-wing government. A victory for the Bolsonaro family would represent a significant shift in regional politics, potentially aligning Brazil more closely with the United States. Meanwhile, a victory for Lula would likely continue his current policies, which often challenge the influence of the U.S. in South American affairs. For now, the people of Brazil must wait to see if their next leader will be decided today or if they will return to the polls later this month.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著全國等待最終結果，這場選舉的影響仍是熱門討論話題。巴西是目前該地區少數仍由左派政府執政的國家之一。波索納洛家族若勝選，將代表區域政治的重大轉向，可能使巴西與美國的關係更加緊密。與此同時，魯拉若勝選，則可能延續其現行政策，持續挑戰美國在南美事務上的影響力。目前，巴西人民只能等待，看下一任領導人會在今天揭曉，還是必須在本月稍晚再次前往投票所。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A competition between candidates to be elected to a position.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「賽跑」，這裡指政治選舉中的競爭。文中：The race features two main candidates with very different ideas: the current left-wing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To defend oneself against a powerful person or group.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 勇敢面對；反抗；不屈服於。
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞與介系詞組成，意思非字面直譯。文中：Lula has presented himself as a leader who is willing to stand up to the United States.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To change from one thing to another.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（開關），這裡作動詞表示改變支持的對象。文中：Flávio Bolsonaro voted in Rio de Janeiro and encouraged supporters of other right-wing candidates to switch their support to him.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A period of time during which someone holds a position or is active.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（跑），這裡作名詞指任期。文中：Lula, who is 80 years old, is looking for a fourth term in office.

quiz.question: What is the requirement for a candidate to win the Brazilian presidential election in the first round?

options.A: They must receive the majority of votes from the major cities like São Bernardo do Campo.
options.B: They must secure more than 50% of the total votes cast.
options.C: They must be the only candidate remaining after the runoff on October 25.
options.D: They must gain the support of voters who previously backed other right-wing candidates.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段明確指出：「To win in the first round, a candidate must receive more than 50% of the total votes.」選項 A 為文中提到的投票地點，非獲勝條件；選項 C 描述的是第二輪選舉（runoff）的情況；選項 D 則是 Flávio Bolsonaro 的競選策略，而非獲勝的法定門檻。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might a supporter of the former president, Jair Bolsonaro, choose to vote for his son, Flávio?

options.A: Because Flávio has promised to pardon his father and release him from prison.
options.B: Because Flávio is the only candidate who has not been involved in any corruption scandals.
options.C: Because the former president is legally barred from running for office himself.
options.D: Because Flávio is the only candidate who opposes the U.S.-led coalition against drug cartels.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第二段提到前總統 Jair Bolsonaro 因試圖以武力奪權正在服刑，第六段中支持者 Claudinei Ferreira Viana 明確表示他原本想投給前總統，但因為對方在服刑（house arrest），所以認為兒子是最好的替代人選。選項 A 文中未提及；選項 B 與第七段提到的醜聞矛盾；選項 D 的敘述與文章第三段關於 Flávio 支持美國立場的描述不符。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does Lula mean when he describes the election as a choice between strengthening democracy and 'barbarism'?

options.A: A state of extreme cruelty, lack of culture, or uncivilized behavior.
options.B: A specific type of economic policy that favors foreign investment.
options.C: An ancient political system that relies on military force.
options.D: A regional movement to remove all current government officials.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境下，「barbarism」（野蠻狀態）被用來與「democracy」（民主）形成強烈對比，意指若對手獲勝，國家將陷入混亂、缺乏文明與法治的狀態。選項 B、C、D 皆非該詞在政治語境中的定義，且文章並未將此詞與特定的經濟政策或古代體制連結。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: To provide a detailed biography of the Bolsonaro family and their political history.
options.B: To analyze the specific military operations conducted by the U.S. in Latin America.
options.C: To explain the historical reasons why Brazil has remained a left-wing government.
options.D: To report on a highly competitive Brazilian election and its potential regional consequences.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章的核心在於報導巴西當前的總統大選，並強調兩位候選人截然不同的立場及其對拉丁美洲政治版圖的潛在影響。選項 A 僅是文章的一部分；選項 B 僅在第三段作為候選人政見的背景提到；選項 C 並非文章重點，文章僅提到巴西是少數維持左翼政府的國家之一，並未深入探討其歷史成因。
